additional_info.subject: RE: 0384649 - ID0384649-DC/Other/NL- [170000480] Charger Offline CRM:02023000194
additional_info.body:
Hello Thomas
the last bootup was in failsafe mode on the storage. There are no other bootup records saved, so I guess that was the point where something happened - maybe the connectivity was interrupted and the customer tried to reboot or something.
Anyway, there's not much we can do remotely. The 10.20.17.2 address is not reachable, and I can't reset the router over putty. At this point, the only way forward is to go on-site with a new router.
However, we can still try to hard reset the router on-site if it's still working (although it seems like it might be dead at this point). If the hard reset doesn't work, we'll need to replace the router and power cycle the charger so the router gets set up properly.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih
